```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}
data_st1 = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(branch(level, 
                       "participant" ~ !c(Order:Number.Characters), 
                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) |> 
  group_by(across(branch(level,
                         "participant" ~ c(ThreadId, Id),
                         "conversation" ~ ThreadId))) |> 
  summarise(branch(level,
                   "participant" ~ across(Type:percent_by_author, unique),
                   "conversation" ~ across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))

parameters(game)
```

```{multiverse default-m-2, inside = game}
data_variables = data_st1 %>%  
  select(branch(dv_iv,

    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "participant") ~

    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "percent_by_author_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "FemaleParticipation_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 5: PLOTS
#' 1. Helper functions

```{r}
# Scatterplot function <- DV-IV relationship
plot_scatter <- function(df, dv, iv) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[iv]], y = .data[[dv]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = iv, y = dv,
         title = "Relationship between the dependent and independent variable")
}

# distribution of the DV and the IV
plot_dist <- function(df, var, bw, ds) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_dotplot(binwidth = bw, dotsize = ds, method = "histodot", stackratio = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = var, y = NULL, title = paste("Distribution of", var))
}

# Parameter function, used when scaling the x and y axes dynamically
dot_params <- function(x, n_bins = 60, aspect = 2) { # aspect: panel width/height
  bw <- diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / n_bins # x axis is cut into 60 bins (so that the binwidth is dynamic, however, the number of bins is 60 either way, regardless of the scale)
  max_stack <- max(table(floor((x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / bw))) # the size of the tallest pile: 
  list(bw = bw, ds = min(1, 0.8 * n_bins / (max_stack * aspect))) # d of dot: bw * ds. the tallest pile: max_stack * ds * bw. height of panel: n_bins * bw / 2 (bc. of the assumed proportion of panel width / height). 
}

# dv-iv separation
split_dv_iv <- function(x) {
  if (str_starts(x, "percent")) {
    dv <- "percent_by_author"
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^percent_by_author_")
  } else {
    dv <- str_extract(x, "^[^_]+")
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^[^_]+_")
  }
  fix <- function(v) if_else(v == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", v)
  list(dv = fix(dv), iv = fix(iv))
}

# variable selection 
get_dv_iv <- function(data) {
  cols <- setdiff(names(data), c("ThreadId", "Id", "Type"))
  list(dv = cols[1], iv = cols[2]) # output = list, function removes all cols but dv and iv, and then selects them. alternative option, used in the multiverse chunk
}
```

#' 2. `multiverse` node - only the plotting code
```{multiverse default-m-6, inside = game}
parts <- get_dv_iv(data_variables)
plot_df <- data_filtered2 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(all_of(c(parts$dv, parts$iv)))

dp_dv <- dot_params(plot_df[[parts$dv]])
dp_iv <- dot_params(plot_df[[parts$iv]])

dv_iv_plot <- plot_scatter(plot_df, parts$dv, parts$iv)
dv_plot <- plot_dist(plot_df, parts$dv, dp_dv$bw, dp_dv$ds)
iv_plot <- plot_dist(plot_df, parts$iv, dp_iv$bw, dp_iv$ds)
```

#' Helper functions

```{r}
# variable handling
get_dv_iv <- function(data) {
  cols <- setdiff(names(data), c("ThreadId", "Id", "Type"))
  list(dv = cols[1], iv = cols[2])
}

# capture model warnings and errors
capture_fit <- function(expr) {
  warnings <- character()

  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      expr,
      warning = function(w) {
        warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = paste(unique(warnings), collapse = " | "),
    error = if (inherits(fit, "error")) conditionMessage(fit) else NA_character_
  )
}

# model summary should be converted into a csv cell
summary_to_text <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(capture.output(print(summary(model))), collapse = "\n")
}
```


```{r}
# make record <- what do we want to store? 
make_record <- function(model, status, model_summary = NA_character_,
                        warnings = NA_character_, note = NA_character_) {
  data.frame(model = model, status = status, summary = model_summary,
             warnings = warnings, note = note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# run one fit, check for errors, then return
run_fit <- function(name, expr) {
  res <- capture_fit(expr)
  if (!is.na(res$error)) {
    list(model = NULL, summary = NULL,
         record = make_record(name, "error", warnings = res$warnings, note = res$error))
  } else {
    list(model = res$fit, summary = summary(res$fit),
         record = make_record(name, "success",
                              model_summary = summary_to_text(res$fit),
                              warnings = res$warnings))
  }
}

# na function <- records note, then output is note
not_applicable <- function(name, note) {
  list(model = NULL, summary = NULL,
       record = make_record(name, "not_applicable", note = note))
}

# model fitter function
fit_models <- function(data, dv, iv) {
  df <- ungroup(data)
  f  <- reformulate(iv, response = dv)
  y  <- df[[dv]]
  y_obs <- y[!is.na(y)]

  # Linear regression
  lm_out <- run_fit("lm", lm(f, data = df))

  # Poisson regression: non-negative integer counts only
  is_count <- is.numeric(y) && length(y_obs) > 0 && all(is.finite(y_obs)) &&
    all(y_obs >= 0) && all(abs(y_obs - round(y_obs)) < 1e-8)
  poisson_out <- if (!is_count) {
    not_applicable("poisson",
      paste0("Poisson regression not applicable: '", dv, "' is not a non-negative integer count."))
  } else {
    run_fit("poisson", glm(f, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = df))
  }

  # Beta regression: only for proportional values (between 0 and 1)
  is_prop <- is.numeric(y) && length(y_obs) > 0 && all(is.finite(y_obs)) &&
    all(y_obs >= 0 & y_obs <= 1)
  beta_out <- if (!is_prop) {
    not_applicable("beta",
      paste0("Beta regression not applicable: '", dv, "' is not a proportional value. Variable must contain numeric values between 0 and 1."))
  } else {
    run_fit("beta", betareg::betareg(f, link = "logit", data = df, type = "ML"))
  }

  # output
  list(
    lm = lm_out, poisson = poisson_out, beta = beta_out,
    records = bind_rows(lm_out$record, poisson_out$record, beta_out$record)
  )
}
```

#' Multiverse chunk, running all analyses
```{multiverse default-m-6, inside = game}
dv_iv_names <- get_dv_iv(data_variables)
model_out   <- fit_models(data_filtered2, dv_iv_names$dv, dv_iv_names$iv)
```

#' Save results in the results_n6 tibble
```{r}
multiverse::execute_multiverse(game)

res_n6 <- multiverse::expand(game)

# mapping results into an object
stats_records <- res_n6 %>%
  transmute(.universe, rec = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$records)) %>%
  unnest(rec) 

# model parameters included, not only the summaries. 
stats_models <- res_n6 %>%
  transmute(
    .universe,
    lm_models      = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$lm$model),
    lm_summaries   = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$lm$summary),
    poisson_ms     = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$poisson$model),
    poisson_sums   = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$poisson$summary),
    beta_models    = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$beta$model),
    beta_summaries = map(.results, ~ .x$model_out$beta$summary)
  )

# left joining the results-only object to the big node tibble
results_n6 <- results_n5 %>%
  left_join(stats_models, by = ".universe")
```
